root_cause.text: The iommu_pt unmap_pages function incorrectly used the originally requested length instead of the actual unmapped length when calculating the TLB invalidation gather range, causing incomplete invalidation when unmap operations extended beyond the requested boundary due to large IOPTE alignment.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes line 1060 in `drivers/iommu/generic_pt/iommu_pt.h` from passing `len` (requested length) to `unmap.unmapped` (actual unmapped length) to the `gather_range_pages()` function, as confirmed by the commit message stating "The gather was only flushing the range requested to be unmapped, not extending to the extra range, resulting in a short invalidation."

vuln_statements.content: struct tlb_gather_mmu tlb; tlb_gather_mmu(&tlb, mm, unmap.start, len);

intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects the length parameter passed to gather_range_pages to reflect the actual unmapped size instead of the requested size.
intent_record.what: Changed the fourth argument of the gather_range_pages function call from len to unmap.unmapped.
intent_record.how: Ensures the TLB gather operation accounts for the actual number of bytes unmapped rather than the originally requested length, aligning TLB invalidation with the true page table state.

grouping_result.intent: Corrects the length parameter passed to gather_range_pages to reflect the actual unmapped size instead of the requested size.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent directly addresses the vulnerability root cause. The root cause identifies that the function incorrectly used the originally requested length instead of the actual unmapped length for TLB invalidation calculations. Group 0 explicitly corrects this by ensuring the length parameter reflects the actual unmapped size.

vuln_statements.stmt_text: struct tlb_gather_mmu tlb; tlb_gather_mmu(&tlb, mm, unmap.start, len);
vuln_statements.explanation: This statement calculates the TLB invalidation gather range using 'len' (the originally requested length) instead of 'unmap.unmapped' (the actual unmapped length). When unmap operations extend beyond the requested boundary due to large IOPTE alignment, this causes incomplete TLB invalidation because the gather range doesn't cover all actually unmapped pages.
